top_signals.title: Saudi Aramco chief says replenishing global oil stockpiles could take two years
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco's CEO warned it could take up to two years to rebuild global oil inventories, saying the squeeze could worsen as the U.S.-Iran war continues.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ethiopian government seizes Tigray capital in blow to rebels
top_signals.summary: Government-allied militia says it gained control of Mekelle after rebel offensive left country on brink of civil war
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOJ to declare underlying inflation has reached 2%, sources say
top_signals.summary: The central bank will express its view as early as Oct. 30 in its next quarterly Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices report.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: NHS may not be able to replace Palantir before £330m deal deadline
top_signals.summary: The NHS may not be able to replace Palantir before a crunch deadline on its £330m data contract, raising the stakes for ministers as pressure mounts to cut ties with the US tech giant. The warning comes as ministers weigh Palantir’s future and campaigners ramp up pressure to ditch the company, with more than 44,000 [...]

top_signals.title: IMF to Use Some Venezuelan Official Data in Its Economic Outlook
top_signals.summary: The International Monetary Fund is set to use some Venezuelan data in its economic estimates for the first time in years, as the Washington-based lender ramps up engagement with the country.

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights Finland's fifth payment request for €229.2 million under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission positively assessed Finland's fifth payment request of €229.2 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

top_signals.title: Scientists win Nobel Prize in medicine for work on ‘light-gated ion channels and optogenetics’
top_signals.summary: Scientists Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel won the 2026 ​Nobel Prize in ‌physiology or ‌medicine.
